verdict.rationale: Vapi's speech configuration docs say developers can control when the assistant starts and stops speaking during a conversation. That is the product's own turn-taking control and covers the 'stopping speech' part of barge-in, but only in a single thin mention. missing for 10: explicit interruption/barge-in detection documentation, evidence that context is updated after an interruption (e.g. truncating unspoken assistant text), evidence of turn recovery behavior, hands-on or independent corroboration of graceful barge-in handling.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on the agent to handle interruptions (barge-in) gracefully — stopping speech, updating context, and recovering the turn

citations.quote: control exactly when your assistant starts and stops speaking during a conversation
